# steps

1. open `http://localhost:4715/`
2. if the 10% off popup shows up, close it
3. tick Shoes in the filters
4. move the price slider so it covers roughly £40 to £80
5. sort by price from high to low
6. add the first product in the list to the wishlist with the heart icon
7. open the second product in the list
8. go back, clear the filters, tick Jackets and sort low to high
9. open the cheapest jacket
10. hover over the zipper on the photo so the zoom shows it
11. choose the red colour and size XL
12. add it to the cart, increase the quantity to 2 in the mini cart and close it
13. scroll the Customers also bought row to the right until the Mini Crossbody is visible
